links.outcome: GPT-4o versus comprehensive ophthalmologists in classifying angle configuration and Shaffer grade
links.effect: GPT-4o had moderate sensitivity (56.3%) for closed angles; comprehensive ophthalmologists achieved higher sensitivity and agreement with the reference standard in both classification tasks.
links.quote: Comprehensive ophthalmologists achieved higher sensitivity and agreement with the reference standard in both classification tasks.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of GPT-4o Shaffer grading across three repeated trials
links.effect: Fair inter-trial consistency for Shaffer grading (Fleiss' Kappa = 0.235); angle configuration accuracy was stable (91.3%, 91.3%, 90.0%).
links.quote: In Shaffer grading, GPT-4o showed moderate agreement with expert consensus (QWK = 0.471-0.573) and fair inter-trial consistency (Fleiss' Kappa = 0.235).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and consistency of a multimodal foundation model (GPT-4o) on gonioscopic images compared against ophthalmologists without testing a deployment practice or workflow safeguard.
